title: Rent Relief payment cap
text: Riverbend Rent Relief pays a maximum of 850 dollars per month toward rent for an eligible household. Payments go directly to the landlord.

title: Tope de pago de la Ayuda de Alquiler
text: El programa de Ayuda de Alquiler de Riverbend paga un máximo de 850 dólares al mes para el alquiler de un hogar elegible. Los pagos se envían directamente al arrendador.

title: Application cycle deadline
text: Applications for the current Riverbend Rent Relief cycle close on March 31 at 5 pm. Applications received after that time are held for the next cycle.

title: Fecha límite del ciclo de solicitudes
text: Las solicitudes del ciclo actual de Ayuda de Alquiler de Riverbend cierran el 31 de marzo a las 5 de la tarde. Las solicitudes recibidas después de esa hora se guardan para el próximo ciclo.

title: Monthly income limits
text: Monthly income limits for Riverbend Rent Relief: a household of one qualifies at or below 1800 dollars, a household of two at or below 2400 dollars, and a household of three at or below 3000 dollars.

title: Límites de ingresos mensuales
text: Límites de ingresos mensuales para la Ayuda de Alquiler de Riverbend: un hogar de una persona califica con 1800 dólares o menos, un hogar de dos personas con 2400 dólares o menos, y un hogar de tres personas con 3000 dólares o menos.

title: Benefits office walk-in hours
text: The Riverbend benefits office accepts walk-ins Monday through Friday from 9 to 4. The office is closed on county holidays.

title: Horario de atención sin cita
text: La oficina de beneficios de Riverbend acepta visitas sin cita de lunes a viernes de 9 a 4. La oficina está cerrada los días festivos del condado.

title: Appealing a denial
text: An applicant may appeal a denial by filing the appeal form with the Riverbend benefits office within 30 days of the decision notice.

title: How to apply
text: Apply for Riverbend Rent Relief online at benefits.riverbend.example.gov or in person at the Riverbend benefits office.

title: Required documents
text: Applicants must provide a photo identification, a current lease, and proof of income for the last 2 months.

title: Who the program serves
text: Eligibility for Riverbend Rent Relief is based on household income, not employment status. Most participating households include at least one working adult.

title: Case information disclosure
text: Staff and automated assistants do not disclose the status of another person's application. Case status is released only to the applicant or an authorized representative.
